The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacy not providing vaccination services uses the special six-support-staff ratio based only on having three certified technicians.
A.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — 1:6 특례는 vaccination services를 제공하는 약국의 조건부 비율이다. certified3명만 있고 예방접종 서비스가 없는 본 보기에는 적용되지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: A dedicated trainer is excluded while independently filling prescriptions between trainee demonstrations.
B.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — trainer가 독립적으로 filling을 하면 training 관계 밖의 professional support이므로 ratio 제외를 유지할 수 없다.

C.original_option_text: One pharmacist supervises three support staff including one licensed intern and two ordinary technicians.
C.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — 1:3의 세 support personnel 중 licensed intern1명이 있어 qualifying slot을 충족한다. 나머지2명이 ordinary technician인 것은 이 조합을 배제하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: An employee scheduled for computer training is excluded while also interrupting modules to fill waiting prescriptions.
D.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — computer exclusion은 지정시간 동안 exclusively modules만 하고 professional support을 하지 않는 조건이다. 대기처방 filling을 병행하면 제외조건이 깨진다.

Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

A.original_option_text: An out-of-state pharmacy ships prescription medications into Massachusetts relying only on its home-state license.

C.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — retired status 자체로는 practice할 수 없다. Board가 lawful return을 허용하지 않은 상태에서 active practice를 하지 않는 것은 맞다. return 승인 권리가 보장되는 것은 아니다.
